title: You Will Never Go Viral If You Don't Learn To Speak On Camera — the same line performed 5x as delivery meters climb 100 views to 1M
fmt: D — performed (subtype: same-line x5 delivery-escalation demo; the performance itself is the teaching)

voice only; onset candidates in grid
